title: pocketbase-cms config
description: Presentation overlay for pocketbase-cms. Field types come from the PocketBase schema (GET /api/cms/schema); this file only says how to show them. It is served publicly from pb_public, so never put secrets here.

logo.description: Path relative to /cms/ or an absolute URL.

locales.description: Content locales for localized fields. The first one is the base locale. Omit for single-language sites.

media.description: Marks one collection as the media library. Image fields with widget "media" pick from it, and the rich text editor inserts images from it.

nav.description: Sidebar groups. Collections not listed here are appended to the last group.

collections.description: Only collections listed here appear in the CMS. Keys are PocketBase collection names.

label.description: A plain string, or one string per UI locale.

singleton.description: Exactly one record; the list screen is skipped.

titleField.description: Field used as the record's name in lists, breadcrumbs and relation pickers. Defaults to the first text field.

status.description: Derives Draft / Scheduled / Published from existing fields. A record is Draft when draftField is true (or publishedField is false), Scheduled when publishedAtField is in the future, otherwise Published.

columns.description: Field names, plus the virtual column "$status".

search.description: Fields matched by the search box. Defaults to [titleField].

form.description: Field placement on the edit screen. Fields in the schema but not placed here go to the end of main, unless hidden.

previewUrl.description: Site page that receives collection, id, token (and locale) by form POST.

widget.description: Overrides the input chosen from the PocketBase field type.

options.description: Display labels for select values, keyed by the stored value.

displayField.description: For relation fields: the field of the related record to show.

slugFrom.description: For slug fields: suggest a slug from this field when empty.

autofill.description: Filled by the CMS when a record is created, and not shown as an input.

localized.description: Groups <name>_<locale> fields into one input with locale tabs.

badge.description: For bool fields: shown as a badge in the list when true.
